name: Rifle
card: An I-70 city west of Glenwood Springs, with local customers and highway traffic.
near: It sits on the Colorado River along I-70.
metaTitle: Rifle Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for Rifle, Colorado. Built for local customers first, with highway traffic handled honestly.
body:
Rifle serves people who live in the Colorado River valley and people who are only passing through on I-70. Those are different customers. A homepage written only for travelers will annoy the neighbors who pay you all year.

I will ask which jobs come from town and which come from the highway, then build the pages and the listing around that split.
extraQ: We get I-70 traffic and local customers. What should the site lead with?
extraA: Lead with the customer you want more of. If locals pay the bills, say you are a Rifle company first and mention travelers where it is true. The Google listing should match the address and the hours, not a slogan.
